rival_lab.name: Rohan
rival_lab.title: Rival
intro: Wait, {PLAYER}! Let's see whose Urumon is stronger. Best of one - no rematches!
defeat: What?! I picked the wrong one... no, I just need practice!

rival_mg.name: Rohan
rival_mg.title: Rival
intro: {PLAYER}! Took you long enough to get through Cubbon Park.
I've been training at the stadium nets every evening. Watch this!
defeat: Arre! I was this close. I'm going to beat Gundappa first, just watch.

rival_whitefield.name: Rohan
rival_whitefield.title: Rival
intro: Silk Board took me three hours. THREE HOURS, {PLAYER}.
I'm in a terrible mood. Perfect for a battle!
defeat: Fine, fine. You're good. Annoyingly good.

rival_palace.name: Rohan
rival_palace.title: Rival
intro: The Syndicate is heading for Nandi Hills. Grandma's worried sick.
Before we go after them, I need to know you're ready. Show me!
defeat: ...Yeah. You're ready. Let's stop them together. You go first - I'll cover the hill roads.

champion.name: Rohan
champion.title: Champion
intro: Hey, {PLAYER}. Surprised? I beat the Council an hour before you.
Every route, every Arena - I was always one step ahead. Or one step behind.
This is it. The Champion of Namma Bengaluru is decided right here. No holding back!
defeat: ...I lost. You really are the best, {PLAYER}.
Grandma's going to be insufferable about this. Congratulations, Champion.

leader_hoovamma.name: Hoovamma
leader_hoovamma.title: Arena Leader
intro: Ah, a young visitor in my Glass House! Mind the orchids, dear.
Sixty years I have tended these gardens. Plants are patient, and patience wins battles.
Show me what you have grown into!
defeat: My, my. You bloom quickly. Take this - the GRASS Badge.
after: Water your Urumon with kindness and they will grow tall.
Keep the GRASS Badge shining, dear. The flower-show crowd will let you pass north now.

leader_gundappa.name: Gundappa
leader_gundappa.title: Arena Leader
intro: Thirty years ago I bowled the fastest spell this stadium ever saw.
Now I coach. Rule one: no fear of the short ball.
Pad up, kid. Let's play!
defeat: Clean bowled! Superb line and length. The FIGHT Badge is yours.
after: The traffic police at the east junction will let you through with that badge.
Silk Board is... well. You'll see. Carry snacks.

leader_tanvi.name: Tanvi
leader_tanvi.title: Arena Leader
intro: Welcome to my startup's demo day! Today's pitch: you, losing.
We iterate fast here. Let's ship this battle!
defeat: Okay, pivot... pivot... no, I'm out of runway. Here's the ELECTRIC Badge.
after: Something weird is going on at Bellandur Lake. My sensors show the foam spiking.
The security folks at the south gate will let a badge-holder through. Go check it out?

leader_vidya.name: Vidya
leader_vidya.title: Arena Leader
intro: Sit down. Notebooks out. Today's lesson: type matchups.
There will be a test. It starts now.
defeat: Full marks. I'm proud of you. Here is the MIND Badge.
after: Revision is the secret. Revisit your weak matchups.
The old palace to the east has a Leader who deals in spirits. Be brave.

leader_rukmini.name: Rukmini
leader_rukmini.title: Arena Leader
intro: The palace was built for a king. Now it belongs to the spirits who stayed behind.
They have been whispering about you... shall we see if they're right?
defeat: The spirits are smiling. They accept you. Take the SPIRIT Badge.
after: The spirits are restless tonight. They say the northern hills are in danger.
Rohan rushed north on Palace Road. You should follow him.

leader_akash.name: Akash
leader_akash.title: Arena Leader
intro: Up here the wind does whatever it wants. Sunrise, mist, monsoon - all in an hour.
My team rides those winds. Can you keep your feet on the ground?
defeat: Grounded! What a battle. You've earned the SKY Badge - your sixth!
after: Six badges! The guards at Vidhana Soudha will open the gates for you now.
Take the Metro back to MG Road. The Namma Council is waiting.

council_nagaraj.name: Nagaraj
council_nagaraj.title: Council
intro: I am Nagaraj of the Namma Council. My Urumon were born where the city's waste goes.
Poison is just what the city leaves behind. Can you survive it?
defeat: You've cleared the fumes. Go on, the next councillor awaits.

council_basappa.name: Basappa
council_basappa.title: Council
intro: Ho ho! Basappa's the name. These rocks are older than the city itself.
You'll need more than a shovel to move them!
defeat: Hah! You dug right through us. Off you go!

council_kaveri.name: Kaveri
council_kaveri.title: Council
intro: Every lake in this city was once full and clear. I fight so they will be again.
Let the water decide who is worthy.
defeat: The water flows your way. One councillor remains.

council_agni.name: Agni
council_agni.title: Council
intro: They call me Agni. I'm the last fire before the Champion.
Let's turn the heat all the way up!
defeat: Burned out... You're the real thing. The Champion is waiting beyond that door.

grunt_cubbon1.name: Grunt
grunt_cubbon1.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: Oi! This park is going to be a parking lot. Move it, kid!
defeat: Ugh. The boss won't like this.
after: We were only cutting the dead trees! ...Mostly.

grunt_cubbon2.name: Grunt
grunt_cubbon2.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: The Concrete Syndicate builds the future! Trees don't pay rent!
defeat: Fine! We'll find another park. There's always another park.

grunt_bell1.name: Grunt
grunt_bell1.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: The foam? Totally natural. Nothing to see here.
defeat: Okay, maybe it's not natural.

grunt_bell2.name: Grunt
grunt_bell2.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: You're not allowed past the hoarding. Site is under construction!
defeat: Our site! Our beautiful site...

grunt_bell3.name: Grunt
grunt_bell3.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: Admin Shetty is busy dumping - I mean, disposing of - very important stuff.
defeat: Shetty sir is going to fire me.

admin_shetty.name: Shetty
admin_shetty.title: Syndicate Admin
intro: Who let a child onto my site? Do you know how much this land is worth per square foot?
This lake is just a very large, very wet plot. And I'm going to fill it.
defeat: Bah! Boss Bhaskar has bigger plans anyway. Up on the hills, the real project begins.
Enjoy your stinky lake, kid.

grunt_nandi1.name: Grunt
grunt_nandi1.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: Halt! The hill is closed for a private event. Very private.
defeat: The private event has been... postponed.

grunt_nandi2.name: Grunt
grunt_nandi2.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: We're going to put a resort on the summit. Infinity pool! Helipad!
defeat: There goes my employee discount.

grunt_nandi3.name: Grunt
grunt_nandi3.title: Syndicate Grunt
intro: The boss is waiting for sunrise. That's when the guardian shows itself.
defeat: Ow. Okay, you can go see the boss. Your funeral.

boss_bhaskar.name: Bhaskar
boss_bhaskar.title: Syndicate Boss
intro: So you're the brat who keeps wrecking my projects.
Do you know what this city needs? Flyovers. Malls. Towers. Concrete.
And the guardian of this 'Garden City' keeps everything green and wet and SLOW.
At sunrise I capture it, and Bengaluru finally becomes what it should be: mine.
Concretor! Pour!
defeat: My Concretor... cracked? By a child?
Fine. FINE. Keep your trees and your lakes and your traffic.
But the city will choose concrete in the end. It always does.

r1_kid.name: Chinnu
r1_kid.title: Schoolkid
intro: Summer holidays! No homework, only battles!
defeat: Waaah! Okay, maybe I'll do my homework.

r1_jogger.name: Priya
r1_jogger.title: Jogger
intro: I jog this road every morning before the traffic starts. Keep up!
defeat: Phew... I need a coconut.

r1_vendor.name: Manju
r1_vendor.title: Street Vendor
intro: Hot bajji! Hot bajji! ...And a battle, if you want.
defeat: Here, take a free bajji for the road. Wait, I ate it.

lb_gardener.name: Ramesh
lb_gardener.title: Gardener
intro: The Glass House is no place for weeds like you!
defeat: You're no weed. You're a whole tree.

lb_college.name: Sneha
lb_college.title: College Student
intro: We're on a botany field trip. You're my field test!
defeat: Note to self: study harder.

cp_bird.name: Arvind
cp_bird.title: Birdwatcher
intro: Shh! I'm counting sparrows. Unless you'd like to battle, quietly.
defeat: Oh! A rare sighting: my own defeat.

cp_jogger.name: Kavitha
cp_jogger.title: Jogger
intro: Ten laps of Cubbon Park before office. Battle you in between!
defeat: Nine laps. Good enough.

cp_kid.name: Tejas
cp_kid.title: Schoolkid
intro: I caught this one near the bandstand!
defeat: I'll catch a stronger one tomorrow.

cp_college.name: Farhan
cp_college.title: College Student
intro: Bunking class to battle? Totally worth it.
defeat: Okay maybe not totally worth it.

st_cricketer1.name: Vinay
st_cricketer1.title: Cricketer
intro: Coach Gundappa says I bowl like a sleepy cow. Let's see what you say!
defeat: Wide ball. Wide everything.

st_cricketer2.name: Shreya
st_cricketer2.title: Cricketer
intro: Nets session is on. You're the batter. I'm the fast bowler.
defeat: Six! Out of the stadium. Wow.

mg_techie.name: Nikhil
mg_techie.title: Techie
intro: I have a standup in ten minutes. This'll be quick.
defeat: ...I'm going to be late for standup.

mg_dancer.name: Lakshmi
mg_dancer.title: Dancer
intro: My Urumon learned their steps at the Ranga Shankara workshop!
defeat: Beautiful footwork. Yours, not mine.

sb_auto1.name: Raju
sb_auto1.title: Auto Driver
intro: Whitefield? Meter plus fifty. Or battle me for a free ride!
defeat: Okay okay, meter only. Final offer.

sb_auto2.name: Shiva
sb_auto2.title: Auto Driver
intro: Signal is red for another forty minutes. Plenty of time!
defeat: Oh, signal is green. Bye!

sb_rider.name: Imran
sb_rider.title: Delivery Rider
intro: Your order is arriving in ten minutes! ...After this battle.
defeat: Order delayed due to unexpected defeat.

sb_techie.name: Divya
sb_techie.title: Techie
intro: I left the office at six. It is now nine. Battle me so I feel productive.
defeat: At least my code compiles.

sb_college.name: Rahul
sb_college.title: College Student
intro: Engineering college in the morning, Silk Board all evening.
defeat: My CGPA and my battle record are similar.

wf_techie1.name: Arjun
wf_techie1.title: Techie
intro: Our Leader's demo day is legendary. Pass my code review first!
defeat: LGTM. Looks good to... you.

wf_techie2.name: Meghana
wf_techie2.title: Techie
intro: Ping! You've got a battle invite. Accept?
defeat: Merged and deployed. Right into the ground.

bl_fisher.name: Bhoja
bl_fisher.title: Fisher
intro: The fish have all gone weird since the foam came.
defeat: Even my Meenu is ashamed of me.

sk_ajja.name: Ramaiah
sk_ajja.title: Ajja
intro: In my day, Sankey Tank was clear enough to see your face in. Let's battle like old times!
defeat: Ha! You remind me of my younger days. Here, have some peanuts.

sk_ajji.name: Saroja
sk_ajji.title: Ajji
intro: Eat properly before you battle, child! You look thin.
defeat: Good, good. Now go eat something.

sk_bird.name: Gautam
sk_bird.title: Birdwatcher
intro: The kites circle highest over Sankey Tank in the afternoon.
defeat: I need better binoculars. And Urumon.

ml_college.name: Ananya
ml_college.title: College Student
intro: Vidya ma'am's tuition is the hardest in the city. Prove you're ready!
defeat: I should revise chapter four again.

ml_kid.name: Pavan
ml_kid.title: Schoolkid
intro: I get top marks in class AND in battles!
defeat: ...I'm crying because of onions. Not because I lost.

pr_dancer.name: Meera
pr_dancer.title: Dancer
intro: The palace corridors are a perfect stage. Watch!
defeat: The spirits applauded you, not me.

pr_ajja.name: Narasimha
pr_ajja.title: Ajja
intro: I've walked past this palace for seventy years and I still hear things at night.
defeat: Brr. You give me shivers too.

pr_cricketer.name: Sachin
pr_cricketer.title: Cricketer
intro: Palace grounds has the best pitch for gully cricket. And battles!
defeat: Run out! By a mile!

hb_rider.name: Faisal
hb_rider.title: Delivery Rider
intro: Delivering biryani to Nandi Hills. Don't ask.
defeat: Biryani's getting cold. Go, go!

hb_wrestler.name: Hanuma
hb_wrestler.title: Wrestler
intro: Morning kusti practice by the lake. You're my sparring partner!
defeat: Pinned! I'm proud of you, small one.

hb_fisher.name: Kiran
hb_fisher.title: Fisher
intro: Hebbal lake's still got some fight in it. Like me!
defeat: Okay, okay, the fish win today. And you.

nh_bird.name: Shalini
nh_bird.title: Birdwatcher
intro: You can see clouds BELOW you up here. Beautiful, isn't it?
defeat: The view is still beautiful. I'm not.

nh_wrestler.name: Bheema
nh_wrestler.title: Wrestler
intro: I climbed the 1,200 steps for training. Every morning!
defeat: ...I'm taking the bus down.

ar_tuition1.name: Rohit
ar_tuition1.title: Schoolkid
intro: Ma'am says whoever loses today gets double homework!
defeat: Double homework... again.

ar_tuition2.name: Kavya
ar_tuition2.title: College Student
intro: I've topped every test in this tuition. Battles are just another test.
defeat: I... got a question wrong?

ar_palace1.name: Leela
ar_palace1.title: Dancer
intro: The palace spirits dance with me at midnight. Care to join?
defeat: The spirits stopped dancing. That's never happened.

ar_palace2.name: Venkatesh
ar_palace2.title: Ajja
intro: I was a palace guard for forty years. I still do my rounds. Out of habit.
defeat: Old legs, young heart. Well fought!

ar_pavilion1.name: Varun
ar_pavilion1.title: Birdwatcher
intro: I paraglide off this hill every weekend. My Urumon taught me how!
defeat: Grounded. Literally.

ar_pavilion2.name: Nandini
ar_pavilion2.title: Jogger
intro: Running up Nandi's steps every morning makes you strong. Like, really strong.
defeat: ...Okay, I need to run more steps.

ar_glass1.name: Shanthi
ar_glass1.title: Gardener
intro: Every plant in this Glass House has a name. This one is called 'Your Defeat'.
defeat: You're sprouting fast, young one.

ar_stadium1.name: Prakash
ar_stadium1.title: Cricketer
intro: I've been twelfth man for six seasons. Today I play!
defeat: Back to carrying drinks, I suppose.

ar_tech1.name: Sahana
ar_tech1.title: Techie
intro: Our Leader built her first startup in her hostel room. I built mine in a hackathon!
defeat: Segfault. Core dumped. That was me.
